interpretation: Per-cell empirical coverage of workflow-budgeted exact-binomial bounds, including VaR selection and all CVaR excess objectives. Ideal independent binomial shots are assumed; deterministic encoding and device errors are excluded. This finite study does not establish cross-cell or hardware coverage.
